title: Resource Board's rail KPI is a percentage between 0 and 100
description: The Resource Board's headline value is passRate = round(compliantResources/totalResources*100), an outcome metric (design doc D1 fix), not a raw resource count — it must never render as a raw count or exceed 100%.
steps: Open /dashboard and read the Resource Board entry's value tile in the module rail (format 'N% pass')
expectedResult: Value is formatted as 'N%' with 0 <= N <= 100.

title: Every one of the 7 module rail entries opens its real board content when clicked — never a blank content pane
description: Dashboard 2.0 rewrite (2026-08-13): AuditOverviewContent's content pane maps selectedBoard to one of ExecutiveSummaryBoardContent/ComplianceBoardContent/ExecutiveResourceBoardContent/VendorBoardContent/ExecutiveRiskBoardContent/AuditBoardContent/FrameworkBoardContent by exact title match against the same 7-entry `boards` array the rail renders from, so every rail entry has a guaranteed matching branch. There is no 'coming soon' fallback text anywhere in the new code (verified: no such string exists) — the failure mode to watch for instead is a blank content pane, which would only happen if a title typo diverged between the rail’s `boards` array and the switch in the render function.
automationRef: test-automation/tests/overview/overview-smoke.test.ts (spec still targets the old modal-dialog pattern for this flow — needs a full rewrite for the rail+inline-content architecture)
steps: Click each of the 7 module rail entries in turn
expectedResult: Each click renders its dedicated board content component; the content pane is never blank for any of the 7 named boards.

title: The dashboard auto-refreshes on a stable 5-minute interval without stacking duplicate timers
description: AuditOverviewContent sets a single setInterval(fetchMetrics, 5*60*1000) in a useEffect keyed on [fetchMetrics] and clears it on cleanup — re-renders must not leave multiple overlapping intervals firing concurrently requests.
steps: Open /dashboard and leave the tab open, monitoring the Network tab for calls to /api/dashboard/metrics
Wait through at least 2 refresh cycles (~10+ minutes) while interacting with unrelated filters
expectedResult: Exactly one /api/dashboard/metrics call fires per 5-minute window from the auto-refresh timer (independent of any manual filter-triggered calls) — never 2+ simultaneous auto-refresh calls.

title: Vendor Board's Avg Trust Score KPI shows a dashed 'Pending' badge, never a fabricated 0, when trust-score inputs aren't populated
description: Dashboard 2.0 rewrite (2026-08-13) changed which vendor metrics are pending: 'Critical Dependencies' is now a real, non-pending KPI (ExecutiveVendorMetricsCards.jsx's criticalDependencyCount, inside the full Vendor Board, not the rail). Only 'Avg Trust Score' remains pending — ExecutiveVendorMetricsCards computes trustScoreAvailable = data.avgTrustScore !== null/undefined and passes pending={!trustScoreAvailable} into the shared KpiStatCard, which renders the value as '—' with a dashed-border 'Pending' badge and a gray accent, and a helpText of 'Trust-score inputs not populated yet'.
steps: Open the Vendor Board and inspect the 'Avg Trust Score' KPI card among the 5 Executive Vendor Metrics cards
Also inspect 'Critical Dependencies' on the same row
expectedResult: 'Avg Trust Score' shows '—' with a dashed 'Pending' badge and the helpText 'Trust-score inputs not populated yet' whenever no vendor has trust-score inputs populated; 'Critical Dependencies' shows a real numeric count (not a Pending badge) reflecting criticalDependencyCount.

title: CarAgingChart shows an explicit zero-state message instead of an empty chart
description: CarAgingChart (Audit Board) buckets overdue CARs into 0-30d/31-60d/61-90d/90+d and shows a red '<n> overdue' badge; when all buckets are 0 it must show 'No overdue corrective actions' rather than a blank/empty bar chart. DEPRECATED: superseded by the Dashboard 2.0 rewrite (2026-08-13) — CarAgingChart.jsx still exists as a file but is no longer imported/rendered anywhere in AuditBoardContent, AuditHealthSnapshotCard, or AuditRegisterCard (the Audit board's redesign comment explicitly notes 'Finding Mix / CAR Aging were dropped from this card in favor of Framework Completion'). The new AuditCarDueListCard lists individual open CARs sorted by due date instead of an aging-bucket chart; see the gap-fill case covering its own empty state.
steps: Open the Audit Board for a project with no overdue corrective actions
expectedResult: The card shows the text 'No overdue corrective actions', not an empty bar chart with a '0 overdue' badge and no explanation.

title: The Retry button after a failed metrics load reissues the call with the currently active filters
description: The error Alert's Retry button calls fetchMetrics(effectiveFilters) — the filters state at the moment of failure — not a hardcoded default filter set.
preconditions: A non-'all projects' filter and a date range are already applied
Backend temporarily returns an error for /api/dashboard/metrics
steps: Apply a date-range filter and a single-project selection
Force the next /api/dashboard/metrics call to fail (e.g. simulate a 500)
Click Retry on the resulting error Alert
expectedResult: The retried request still carries the same date range and project selection, not the default 'all projects, all time' filter set.

title: ComplianceControlsModal shows real, server-paginated control rows and an em-dash (not $0) for controls with no cost data
description: ComplianceControlsModal.jsx (new in Dashboard 2.0) is opened from ComplianceBoardContent either via a general 'view controls' action (unfiltered) or by clicking a coverage-status segment (pre-filtered to that coverageStatus), and fetches real rows via executiveComplianceBoardService.getComplianceControls with search/coverageStatus/criticality filters and page-based pagination. Its 'Est. Cost to Close' column renders '—' when a control has neither an estimatedCost nor estimatedEffortHours value, rather than a fabricated $0.
steps: Open the Compliance Board and click a 'Gap' coverage segment to drill in
Inspect the modal's rows and the 'Est. Cost to Close' column for a control with no cost data on record
expectedResult: The modal opens pre-filtered to coverageStatus='gap' with real control rows (name, ucl code, domain, criticality, owner, evidence count); a control with no cost/effort data shows '—' in the Est. Cost to Close column, never '$0'.

title: FrameworkCrosswalkModal shows an explicit 'no mappings exist yet' message instead of a blank table for an unmapped framework pair
description: FrameworkCrosswalkModal.jsx (new in Dashboard 2.0, opened via the Framework Board's 'Crosswalk' button, disabled unless the org has 2+ active frameworks) fetches CrossFrameworkControlMapping rows for the selected framework pair. When data.crosswalk is empty, it renders explanatory text ('No cross-framework mappings exist yet between <A> and <B>. Mappings are curated per organization — none have been created for this pair.') rather than an empty table.
preconditions: Org has 2+ active frameworks with no curated CrossFrameworkControlMapping rows between at least one pair of them
steps: Select a framework pair with no curated mapping
expectedResult: The modal shows the explicit 'No cross-framework mappings exist yet...' message (naming both selected frameworks) instead of a blank/empty table.
